newsitem.title: UK: Hill Samuel Asset Mgmt wins 100 mln stg mandate.
newsitem.headline: Hill Samuel Asset Mgmt wins 100 mln stg mandate.

text.p: Hill Samuel Asset Management (HSAM) said on Thursday it had been appointed as UK smaller companies manager for the Strathclyde Pension Fund to manage a 100 million sterling mandate.
It was previously held by M&G Group, who sources said was shortlisted for the mandate with Hill Samuel and Gartmore Investment Management.

HSAM said it was its third institutional win in 1997, after receiving a 37 million stg fixed income mandate from TSB Insurance Fund and a 15 million cash management mandate from Wycombe District Council.
The institutional arm of HSAM has 10.9 billion stg under management, of which 620 million is in smaller companies.
